principles.statement: Define cold-start placement by the product decision it must support: selecting a useful next learning region, not certifying one global English level.
Represent initial learner state as a provisional profile with uncertainty, not as a permanent CEFR label or mastered/not-mastered vector.
Use self-reported history, goals and can-do judgments only as routing priors or context; direct performance evidence must be able to override them immediately.
Maintain an item bank with genuinely informative near-A0 and low-A1 tasks; do not assume an A1-to-C1 bank can safely place a true beginner.
Start with a small common anchor set, then spend additional probes only near uncertain learner frontiers or high-cost placement boundaries.
Use both minimum and maximum stopping rules: do not terminate after an implausibly tiny sample, and do not trap uncertain learners in an open-ended placement test.
Balance adaptive information gain with construct coverage so a short test cannot become a narrow grammar/vocabulary quiz that masquerades as whole-language placement.
Keep listening, reading, lexical/construction, speaking and writing evidence separable; infer only what the administered task actually elicited.
Do not require every expensive productive probe at cold start; trigger speaking or writing probes when they can change the next-learning decision or resolve important uncertainty.
Explain briefly that the assessment adapts and begin with comprehensible, confidence-preserving tasks rather than optimizing pure information at the expense of learner experience.
Treat ambiguous boundary cases as uncertainty to manage, not as forced precision; route conservatively or collect another targeted probe.
Validate placement by downstream consequences: first-session appropriateness, support dependence, skipped-known material, struggle, early learning gain and placement corrections.
After placement, continue low-stakes calibration from normal learning attempts using an explicit claim-evidence-task mapping; raw clicks, time or completion are not language evidence by themselves.
Allow early-session evidence to override the cold-start prior quickly so an initial misplacement does not contaminate the learner model for weeks.
Use CEFR or similar scales only as optional reporting mappings after the local capability decision; they do not define Nếp's curriculum starting node by themselves.
Keep anchor count, uncertainty thresholds, route modules, self-report weight, maximum time and recalibration window falsifiable until EXP-021 validates them for Vietnamese near-A0/A1 adults.
